name: Xia Mo Baiye
source:
On the well-known forum of Baiyue High School, "Baiyue Park," a creepy story post became popular throughout the entire campus in just a few days. Although it was clearly a fake post, it still became a pastime for students during their breaks, with many believing it to be true. The "realist" high school student Zhou Teng, who does not believe in ghosts or gods, naturally dismissed the story described in the post. That was until strange events began to happen one after another around him...

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538910/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在百月高中的知名论坛“百月公园”上，一个令人毛骨悚然的故事帖子短短几天就火遍了整个校园。尽管这显然是一个假帖子，但它仍然成为学生课间的消遣，许多人相信这是真的。不相信鬼神的“现实派”高中生周腾自然对帖子中描述的故事不屑一顾。直到他的身边开始接二连三发生奇怪的事情……
